title: Stream event
summary: Normalized event emitted when a compatible runtime provider implements streaming.
purpose: Represents ordered run progress, output, completion, or failure events.
lifecycle: Produced while streamRun is active and ends at terminal event, abort, or transport failure.

fieldConstraints.constraint: Required member of the packed RunStreamEvent discriminated union.

behavior.errors: Transport failures reject streamRun; error events carry normalized upstream failure information.
behavior.retry: Reconnect and deduplication behavior is provider-specific unless documented by that provider.
behavior.cancellation: AbortSignal stops local consumption; upstream cancellation requires cancelRun support.
behavior.streaming: Support is conditional and must be checked before invocation.

valid.expected: The matching handler receives incremental text.

invalid.expectedFailure: The discriminator is not a packed RunStreamEvent variant.

compatibilityNotes: Event ordering and resumability beyond the normalized union remain upstream-owned.
